```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Text'>">
  %ent;
  <?target-pi data="processing-instruction"?>
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Top level comment block exploring parser boundaries -->
  <sub:child xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tags>, &internal;, and unescaped entities!
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; and Second">
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ELEMENT complex (#PCDATA)>">
  %pe;
  <?pi-target processing instruction data with special &ent1; reference?>
]>
<doc xmlns="http://ns.example.org/doc" xmlns:m="http://ns.example.org/meta">
  <!-- Comment in doc root -->
  <m:section m:id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA block with arbitrary markup: <section>&ent2;</section>
    ]]>
  </m:section>
  <section>&ent2;</section>
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "Catalog Base">
  <!ENTITY extended "&base; Extension">
  <!NOTATION jpeg SYSTEM "image/jpeg">
  <!ENTITY photo SYSTEM "photo.jpg" NDATA jpeg>
  <?catalog-action execute="refresh"?>
  <!ENTITY % pfx "<!ATTLIST item id ID #IMPLIED>">
  %pfx;
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://www.example.com/catalog" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">
  <!-- Comment explaining the catalog structure -->
  <item id="i1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with <item> markup &extended;
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item id="i2">&extended;</item>
</catalog>
```

  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock*)>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY itemA "Standard Item">
  <!ENTITY itemB "&itemA; - Deluxe">
  <?inventory-meta status="active"?>
  <!ENTITY % extDef "<!ENTITY dynamicEntity 'Dynamic Value'>">
  %extDef;
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">

    <![CDATA[
      CDATA text block: &dynamicEntity; inside CDATA.
    ]]>
  </stock>
  <stock>&dynamicEntity;</stock>
</inventory>

  <!ELEMENT archive (record*)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>

  <!ENTITY rec2 "&rec1; Beta">
  <?archive-ctrl version="2.0"?>

  <!ENTITY % param "<!ELEMENT meta (#PCDATA)>">

]>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/schema" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <!-- Archive metadata comment block -->
  <record dc:identifier="001">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw archive CDATA with entities &rec2; and tags <record>.
    ]]>
  </record>
  <record>&rec2;</record>
</archive>

  <!ENTITY val1 "Value One">

<registry xmlns="http://registry.org/ns" xmlns:pub="http://registry.org/pub">

<!DOCTYPE suite [
  <!ELEMENT suite (test*)>
  <!ELEMENT test (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY tname "Test Suite Name">
  <!ENTITY tdesc "&tname; Description">
  <?suite-runner engine="default"?>
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY logFile SYSTEM "run.log" NDATA txt>
  <!ENTITY % macroAttr "<!ATTLIST test status CDATA #IMPLIED>">
  %macroAttr;
]>
<suite xmlns="http://suite.org/schema" xmlns:cfg="http://suite.org/config">
  <!-- Configuration and test suite comment -->
  <test status="pass">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA execution log: &tdesc; <test>
    ]]>
  </test>
  <test status="pending">&tdesc;</test>
</suite>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE portal [
  <!ELEMENT portal (module*)>
  <!ELEMENT module (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY modA "Module A">
  <!ENTITY modB "&modA; Enhanced">
  <?portal-hook trigger="load"?>
  <!ENTITY % pDecl "<!ELEMENT description (#PCDATA)>">
  %pDecl;
]>
<portal xmlns="http://portal.org/ns" xmlns:ui="http://portal.org/ui" xmlns:sec="http://portal.org/sec">
  <!-- Portal security and module comment block -->
  <ui:module sec:level="high">
    <![CDATA[
      Protected CDATA content: &modB; <module>
    ]]>
  </ui:module>
  <module>&modB;</module>
</portal>

  <!ENTITY % paramMacro "<!ATTLIST artifact id ID #IMPLIED>">

  <!-- Repository artifact metadata comment -->
  <artifact id="a1">
    <![CDATA[
      Artifact payload CDATA: &art2; <artifact>
    ]]>
  </artifact>
  <artifact id="a2">&art2;</artifact>
</repository>
